displayName: GHADV-2237: Apache DolphinScheduler: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allows authenticated users to access alert instances a
description:
Apache DolphinScheduler: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allows authenticated users to access alert instances associated with alert groups they do not have permission to access.

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition
